configs.description: Chassis only - what you spec before deciding what goes in it. The 4 slot bays are EMPTY; cooling, psus, res are populated. Enough to power on and reach the box, which is the question most people ask first and the one `default` used to answer with whatever the drawing happened to be populated with. The line-card slots are drawn EMPTY rather than blanked, which is not the intent: no MX10000-series line-card blank is modelled, and none is named in the staged guides - they document power-supply cover panels only. Every other chassis in the library seats a blank here.
configs.name: base

gaps.wanted: a photograph of a real RCB's model label. The board in this chassis's own photographs carries four SFP cages numbered 0-3 and no BITS, ToD, RESET or Online/Offline hardware, which matches neither Juniper faceplate figure - not Figure 46 (JNP10K-RE1 family, two reserved XGE cages) nor Figure 45 (JNP10K-RE3 family). juniper/jnp10k-re1@2 follows the figure it is named for; the detail is in provenance/which-board-the-photographs-show on that contract. The label does not resolve at the scale of any photograph held here.
the JNP10K-PWR-AC3, DC2 and DC3 faces (AC3 adds four feeds A0/A1/B0/B1 and six LEDs; only AC2 is photographed usably).
LC2101, LC4800 and LC4802 faceplates - the guide names them and gives dimensions and power, but the extraction has no usable face art; only LC9600 and LC480 are modelled.
legible FPC slot labels - the top-down 0-3 order follows the family convention, not a readable print.
a vendor dimension for the RCB face - the FRU table covers chassis, cards and PSUs but not the RCB; 389 mm is photo-derived.
per-tray power draw - not in the extraction's text layer.

an `attrs.performance` section; `cpu`, `memory` in a missing `attrs.platform` section; one of `power-max-w`, `power-max-ac-w`, `power-max-dc-w` in a missing `attrs.power` section; one of `operating-temp`, `operating-temp-f2b`, `operating-temp-b2f` in a missing `attrs.environmental` section (profile `networking` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
`physical-context` on 11 bays (front 6, rear 5) - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays

chassis.note: datasheet-table - 12.2 x 17.4 x 36.7 in (310 x 442 x 932 mm with fan trays), 7U; flange extends the rack face to 19 in. Ears NOT MODELLED by convention

color.note: photo - dark grey chassis, silver card faces, light-blue levers and accent line under the badge strip

front.note: photo - the frontwtop photograph at ~3.11 px/mm across the 442 mm body: badge strip 0-20, RCB slots at y 20.0 and 58.1 (guide FRU listing gives the 1.5 in slot height), blank service band to y 118, then four 48 mm line-card rows at y 118/166/214/262 (the 1.89 in card height is the vendor FRU table). The status lamp panel at the right of the RCB block is chassis metal, drawn as decor with its lamp column

other-faces.note: near-blank by evidence - rail bands estimated; axis conventions per viewer3d.js as the siblings

power.note: datasheet-table - the guide capacity table: two JNP10K-PWR-AC2 at high power deliver 11,000 W, three 16,500 W

rear.note: photo - the rear studio figure g101087 anchored per-axis to the 442 mm body: PSU stack ~84 mm wide at the left (PSU 0 top, PSU 2 bottom, as the printed arrows in the figure), two ~176 mm fan trays filling the rest

slot-numbering.note: guide - FPC 0-3; drawn top-down 0-3 to match the MX10000-family convention, but no extracted figure prints the slot labels legibly - see gaps

sources.note: MX10004 Hardware Guide (424 pages, 182 figures), the shared MX10000 datasheet, the frontwtop studio photograph and the rear studio figure g101087
